p.s: I agree this statement that young people enjoy life more than older people do.
It is because the young have much physical energy, they can try what they want, and they can make use of that experiences for the future life.
First, the young are endowed with powerful energy more than the old.
Because they are on growing in case of children and keep going to live, they have physical energy.
Because they have much energy, they can do many activities in a day.
For example, they go to school, participate in club activity, and have other extra possibilities such as to talk with friends, to study, and so on.
In contrast, the old cannot all of those staffs in a day because of their lack of energy, compared to the young.
Because they have enough energy, the young can work a lot and get knowledge and experience from there.
Second, the young can try whatever they want.
For example, the young who have dreams can try to make that come true.
They can use time, devote themselves, and try to expand their ability.
In such case, the life becomes really efficient and briliant.
They have what they want and actually there is possibility, and they can try.
The possibilities are unlimited and the young can try those over and over again.
However, the old cannot do that because their remained life time is possibly limited.
Last, the young can use the experience to benefit their future lives.
After trial, even if they are not succesful for that dreams, they learn from the attempts and get life experience.
In addition to that, because they have enough time after that, they can make use of that fruitful experiences and can make their lives much better.
The old, however, have limited time for their life and cannot do that.
The old have abundant exprience and mayhe have children and grand children to teach that experience.
Nevertheless, they no not have time to expand that experience by themselves.
Above all, I believe that the young enjoy life more than the older people.
Because their potential and energy are limittess, they can do many works and things much more than older people.
